title: AuthZed May 2026 Release
summary: Remove authorization bottlenecks, empower your team to innovate and expand with best-in-class performance at any scale.
body_markdown:
This release cycle brings an experimental unified schema storage mode to SpiceDB, takes the query planner further toward distributed execution, refreshes the SpiceDB Playground, and updates all of the official client libraries to the latest API.


---


### SpiceDB


#### Experimental Unified Schema Storage ([v1.53.0](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb/releases/tag/v1.53.0) )


SpiceDB can now store your whole schema as a single record instead of one record per definition, which makes loading the schema significantly faster.


This is opt-in and experimental. You enable it with the` --experimental-schema-mode` flag and migrate in stages using rolling restarts. The SpiceDB Operator can step through the stages for you. See the[release notes](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb/releases/tag/v1.53.0) for each stage.


#### Query Planner: Dispatch Support ([v1.53.0](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb/releases/tag/v1.53.0) )


The experimental query planner can now spread work across SpiceDB nodes and cache the results, like the existing engine does. It also simplifies queries before running them.


For a look at what this means for performance, read[Query Planner Early Benchmarks](https://authzed.com/blog/query-planner-early-benchmarks) . Still experimental and not recommended for production.


---


### SpiceDB Operator


#### Credential Secret Fixes ([v1.25.0](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb-operator/releases/tag/v1.25.0) /[v1.25.1](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb-operator/releases/tag/v1.25.1) )


Clusters that reference more than one Kubernetes secret no longer run into conflicts, and a crash related to credential configuration is fixed. The operator also supports upgrading to SpiceDB v1.52.0.


---


### Client Libraries


- **Go** ([authzed-go v1.10.0](https://github.com/authzed/authzed-go/releases/tag/v1.10.0) ): when you download permission sets from Materialize, the response now tells you which revision the snapshot reflects.
- **Node.js** ([authzed-node v1.7.0](https://github.com/authzed/authzed-node/releases/tag/v1.7.0) ) and **Java** ([authzed-java v1.6.0](https://github.com/authzed/authzed-java/releases/tag/v1.6.0) ): updated to the latest AuthZed API.


---


### Developer Tools


#### SpiceDB Playground Refresh


The[SpiceDB Playground](https://play.authzed.com/) received a UI refresh and a reworked tab system. You can now edit your schema and relationships in the same view, and there are new example schemas to start from.[Read the announcement](https://authzed.com/blog/spicedb-playground-update) .


#### VS Code Extension ([v1.2.0](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb-vscode/releases/tag/v1.2.0) )


The SpiceDB VS Code extension adds YAML validation file support, checks the installed SpiceDB version on launch, and fixes several syntax highlighting issues.
